mechanism.claim: The sign of BTC's response to high-volatility twelve-hour shocks is regime-dependent. A causal memory of only already-completed comparable shocks can identify whether the current regime rewards continuation or reversal without selecting a fixed direction from future stages.
mechanism.side: current completed shock sign multiplied by the strict sign of the mean signed response of the latest 32 already-completed eligible shocks
mechanism.why_distinct: The 2026-07 causal-online-expert experiment selected among six outcome-contaminated legacy sleeves over a hyperparameter grid. HVCRMR has no expert pool, no sleeve reuse, no grid, no adverse-utility selection, and no future-stage ranking. It is one price-response law with one fixed memory and clock.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: only source-calibrated upper-tail twelve-hour range and displacement shocks can enter the response memory or signal.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: Gross9 has no causal high-volatility response-memory state or fixed twelve-hour shock clock.

features.shock_return: log(last completed close/first open); strict nonzero
features.calibration: 2023H1 exact boundaries only: abs(shock_return) q60 and range_vol q65; no emitted OOS incidence or current-event post-entry outcome
features.counterfactual_response: for an eligible opportunity at U, sign(shock_return[U])*log(open[U+12h+5m]/open[U+5m]); it becomes available only at U+12h+5m
features.memory: latest 32 counterfactual responses whose availability<=current decision D; at least 16; arithmetic mean must be strict nonzero

clock.reservation: fixed boundaries are naturally half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: current emitted-event outcomes sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass; already-completed counterfactual responses are causal signal inputs

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no calibration, memory, minimum history, response, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
